problems.title: FizzBuzz
problems.prompt: Print numbers 1..15, but print `Fizz` for multiples of 3, `Buzz` for multiples of 5, and `FizzBuzz` for multiples of both.
hints: Use elsif for the 3 and 5 cases.
problems.solution:
(1..15).each do |i|
  if i % 15 == 0
    puts "FizzBuzz"
  elsif i % 3 == 0
    puts "Fizz"
  elsif i % 5 == 0
    puts "Buzz"
  else
    puts i
  end
end
problems.expectedOutput:
1
2
Fizz
4
Buzz
Fizz
7
8
Fizz
Buzz
11
Fizz
13
14
FizzBuzz

problems.title: Slugify a title
problems.prompt: Implement `slugify` that lowercases, replaces non-alphanumerics with hyphens, and strips leading/trailing hyphens. Print slugify("Ahoy, Crew!").
problems.starterCode:
def slugify(title)
  # TODO
end

puts slugify("Ahoy, Crew!")
problems.solution:
def slugify(title)
  title.downcase.gsub(/[^a-z0-9]+/, "-").gsub(/^-|-$/, "")
end

puts slugify("Ahoy, Crew!")
